blocks.text: This synthetic design note proposes driving RESET_N low using GPIO3_IO12, waiting for a configured 10 ms delay, and releasing RESET_N before enabling the peripheral. No electrical timing was measured.
The configured delay describes firmware intent; this fixture contains no electrical timing measurement.
